name: mixed-joins
description: The quick first check: every join mode once, 3 s shots. Rain on a cafe window, a seamless continue, a cut that keeps the rain's sound under a new picture, then a fresh unrelated shot.

shots.prompt: Close-up of rain running down a cafe window at night, neon signs blurred behind the glass, steady soft rain sound
The camera slowly drifts along the same rainy cafe window, droplets merging and sliding down, neon reflections shimmering, steady soft rain sound
Inside the cafe, a cup of coffee steams on a wooden table beside the rainy window, warm lamp light, the same soft rain sound outside
Aerial shot over an autumn forest with a winding river, morning mist, gentle wind
